sections.title: 1. Redundant Computations in `TrainingLogCard`
2. Redundant `logs.filter` passes in `buildWeeklyReport`
3. Unnecessary Re-renders — Missing `useCallback` in `LogScreen`
4. Caching Opportunity — `getWeakLogReasons` Called Per List Item
5. Potential Memory Leak — `getQuickTemplates` Creates `new Date()` on Every Call
6. N+1-style Pattern — `DashboardScreen` Filter Passes
Summary Table
sections.content:
| Issue | File | Severity | Fix Type |
|---|---|---|---|
| Double `getWeakLogReasons` call | `TrainingLogCard.tsx` | Medium | Remove `logNeedsImprovement` call |
| Redundant filter passes | `reportBuilder.ts` | Low | Combine into single loop |
| Inline function refs causing re-renders | `LogScreen.tsx` | Medium | `useCallback` |
| `getWeakLogReasons` per-card render | `LogScreen.tsx` + `TrainingLogCard.tsx` | Medium | `useMemo` map in parent |
| `getQuickTemplates` creates `Date` per render | `TrainingLogForm.tsx` | Low | `useMemo` |
| 7 separate `logs` iterations on Dashboard | `DashboardScreen.tsx` | Medium | Single-pass `useMemo` |
